title: Jesus Cried Too
themeTags: God is close when we hurt
reflectionQuestion: Jesus loved his friends so much that he cried right along with them. I wonder what it feels like to know God is that close to you, even when you are sad?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Jesus' Miracles). Emotional center per Adam = Mary crying + Jesus crying -> then hope; NOT 'dead man comes back'. Protected line: 'Jesus loved his friends so much that he cried right along with them.' Grief handled gently: Lazarus 'had died' (soft), no tomb/decay detail, no four-days, the raising kept warm and brief for the hopeful last word. Death-of-a-loved-one flag set; routes a grieving/sad child (mood hurting -- lane is thin here). Soft-consonant close ('always'). God-with-not-cause honored: God does not cause the death; Jesus weeps WITH them. VOICE_JOHN_BELOVED (John's own gospel; tender, intimate).
